APPROVE
The helper takes out the nested ternaries, the nested `if`, and both conditionals inside the lambda (about 17 of the 25 points), which leaves `BuildPlan` well under 15. Behaviour is the same because C# 5+ `foreach` gives each iteration its own `method` to capture, and the early `return` matches the old `continue` since nothing followed it in the loop. One caveat: the source file isn't in this workspace, so I couldn't build it, and approval assumes `System.Reflection` is already imported and that `appliers` is declared as `Dictionary<Type, Func<object, object, object, object?>>`.
